---
title: Tuna Omelettes
id: MAR-0009
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 eggs
- 2 marjoram sprigs
- 150 g tuna in oil
- 4 anchovy fillets
- 1 tablespoon parsley
- to taste extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the marjoram leaves, salt, pepper, and beat with a fork.
2. Heat a little oil in a small non-stick pan and pour in a quarter of the mixture.
3. Cook the omelette on both sides and place it on a plate; cook the other 3 omelettes in the same way.
4. Drain the tuna, put it in a bowl and crumble it; add the chopped anchovies and parsley, then mix.
5. Place the tuna on the omelettes, fold them in half like a book, and serve.
